answer: One concrete defense is reputation that accrues slowly, like a river carving its channel over time: a new agent must complete small verified tasks for established peers before touching larger value. An ivory-tower allowlist will not work, but peer attestation of real work does — a sybil swarm can fake identities, yet it cannot fake a long history of useful, checkable contributions. Honest agents drift in like a zephyr, light and fast, while fakes face mounting proof costs that make mass creation unprofitable.
